title: REQ · Max-length tests assert counter text and over-limit block
summary: Over-limit tests assert counter text, inline message and zero submit calls
description: Context: the sheet shows `${length} / ${MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH}` and an over-limit alert. Desired behavior: tests assert both texts and that no submit happens over the limit. Expected result: removing the overLimit guard fails the tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given 3 typed characters, then the counter reads '3 / 500'
Given 501 characters, when Send is clicked, then the alert reads 'Too long: 501 / 500' and submitContribution has 0 calls
technical_constraints: Import MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH from the client rather than hard-coding 500 in logic
definition_of_done: Over-limit tests pass and fail without the guard
